question:
Simplify:
√12 + √75
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Factorize the numbers inside the roots into perfect squares:

√12 = √(4 × 3) = 2√3

√75 = √(25 × 3) = 5√3

Add the similar surds: 2√3 + 5√3 = 7√3

**∴ The correct answer is 7√3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = √12 + √75

**Concept Used:**

√(a × b) = √a × √b (Identify the largest perfect square factor)

**Calculations:**

⇒ √12 + √75

⇒ √(4 × 3) + √(25 × 3)

⇒ √4 × √3 + √25 × √3

⇒ 2×√3 + 5×√3

⇒ (2 + 5)√3

⇒ 7√3

**∴ The correct answer is 7√3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Surds

Multiplication: √(ab) = √a × √b | Division: √(a/b) = √a ÷ √b.

Like Surds

Surds that have the exact same irrational factor are known as like surds (e.g., 2√3 and 5√3). Only like surds can be directly added or subtracted together.

BODMAS in Simplification

Always simplify the contents under roots or brackets before performing addition or subtraction when solving surd equations.
